Element.Description: Lower inclusive bound for the random number of charge attacks before Alpha Blogg enters a three-charge sequence. Both bounds are converted to unsigned 8-bit values. A selected count of zero disables this trigger.

Upper inclusive bound for the random number of charge attacks before Alpha Blogg enters a three-charge sequence. Both bounds are converted to unsigned 8-bit values. A selected count of zero disables this trigger.
Probability of choosing a charge when Alpha Blogg faces the player without a pending projectile-attack result. Projectile count, full aggressiveness and forced attack modes can also permit a charge.

Probability rolled when Alpha Blogg next faces the player after a projectile attack. The result controls melee-attack permission and is checked by the charge gate while a projectile result is pending. Forced attack modes bypass these restrictions.
Probability that Alpha Blogg will open its mouth during a charge when the player enters charge range. A pending projectile-attack result forces mouth opening regardless of this probability.
